title: Vandal capture of Carthage and the Vandal kingdom in North Africa
note: Loss of the West's richest tax province; Gaiseric's 39-year reign from Carthage (Procopius, Vandal War I.3-7 on LacusCurtius); DIR Valentinian III says nearly all North Africa lost by 439. Exact day of capture (19 October 439 in Prosper) still needs an opened source. Under-recorded region for the 5th century.

title: Gothic crossing of the Danube and the refugee famine of 376-377
note: Non-elite history: starving Tervingi forced to hand over their own people, including chieftains' sons, as slaves in exchange for dogs as food under Lupicinus and Maximus (Ammianus 31.4.11, LacusCurtius); Hun displacement in 375 (Lenski, DIR Valens). Crossing point not fixed in sources opened so far.

title: Galla Placidia
note: Woman at the centre of western politics: captive of Alaric's Goths in 410, wife of Athaulf and of Constantius III, regent for Valentinian III; mausoleum at Ravenna. Birth year approximate and must be sourced; DIR has a Galla Placidia entry to start from.

title: Hunnic advance north of the Black Sea
note: Trigger of the Gothic migrations (Ammianus 31.2-3; Lenski, DIR Valens; Heather in the OUPblog dialogue). Steppe origins and any Xiongnu link are contested: needs perspectives and archaeological/genetic sources. Primary region may be europe (Pontic steppe) once sourced.

title: Ostrogothic kingdom of Italy under Theodoric
note: Theodoric displaces Odoacer (Anonymus Valesianus; Jordanes, Getica 46-57); Ravenna monuments (Mausoleum of Theodoric). Should be a polity record with dated borders.
